item.title: Cycle track and road needs to be made safe, 8th August
item.description:
This link section or cycle/pedestrian path and road beside the football ground, leading to Sainsbury's is a very well used route. It is however in great need to repair and resurfacing. The pedestrian area is all cracked and there is no sensible link for cyclists from the road. Better lighting and a more safer environment with CCTV needs to be made. Also, proper gates to stop mopeds speeding through. I have had to avoid this area at night due to antisocial and untoward behaviour. This whole stretch, up to the park needs to be improved - and it would be most gratefully received by the many young families that frequent this area.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Burrow Road, East Dulwich, Greater London

item.title: Bike lights, 8th August
item.description:
As with all other duel traffic lights - one set for bicycles to go before cars - these new lights have not been properly set up. At present both bicycle and car lights go at the same time - this is very dangerous and I have seen many near misses. Please can the bicycle lights be set to go green a few seconds before the car lights to give safer clearance to the main junction. This is especially needed before the new school term begins. Many thanks.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Village Way, Dulwich Village, Greater London

item.title: Very dangerous road, 8th August
item.description:
This whole area of road is treacherous - manhole covers protruding or sunken down, disintegrated road surface, uneven crossing to school entrance. All this means both bikes and cars have to swerve to avoid - notably over the speed bump nearest the station coming down the hill, there are sunken holes from car wheels - cars have to swerve to avoid. This all needs resurfacing urgently, ideally before the new school term.

item.title: Blinding light shining in my home, 8th August
item.description:
A street light on top of the building has always been present at 26 Norcroft Gardens SE22 0BH. It was yellow and not too disturbing. However, this was changed and it’s now extremely bright and blinding. It shines directly inside my property and makes it very difficult to use that side of the flat (the kitchen and dining area), once it’s dark outside and the light is on. I would like to ask for the light to be changed to something less invasive, far dimmer or ideally motion triggered, as it’s also a huge waste of electricity to keep it on all night. Either way, I would like to ask assistance urgently, as I have a very young baby, who is also being impacted.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 26, Norcroft Gardens, East Dulwich, Greater London
